spans.s: kuḍirai-ppandi (SITI), Tamil; ‘a stable’; tax for the same.
kuḍirai-vari (SITI), Tamil; tax on horses; also known as kudirai-mār̤r̤u, kudiraiv-ilāḍam; probably the same as kudirai-ppandi.
kuḍiraiv-ilāḍam (SITI), Tamil; ‘horse-shoe’; fee for shoeing horses; probably connected with kudirai-ppandi.
